reviews.text: The care towards my pet exemplary. It was such a lovely experience to know that my pet was treated with care. The follow up conversations were also brilliant
Professional team and great service!
Really helpful and friendly - my dog had torn her dew claw and they squeezed me in between two appointments to deal with immediately - thank you!

Had a really positive experience with Daisy at Medivet Notting Hill. She was so lovely and helpful on the phone and handled everything really nicely. She made the whole process feel easy and reassuring, and her customer service was amazing. Really appreciate how kind and professional she was. Thank you Daisy! ❤️
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Lovely staff, super helpful. Dr Rosie was gentle, professional, and very patient. We had a lovely experience. Highly recommend 10/10

The vets are so lovely and caring. And they don’t try and get you to pay more money l for things your pet doesn’t need.  They are honest and do whats best for you pet! And the staff are also so nice x

My cat  had her claws trimmed quickly and well without upsetting her although she can be difficult when her claws are trimmed.  However  her carrier was not properly fastened when she was returned to it and  I went home so she could have escaped if someone passing  had not noticed  the front grill was unfastened,
Always friendly and helpful
We are very happy with our Vet. Pixel our dog is not afraid to go there, and we are always made to feel welcome and taken care of.

I had my first visit to this vet and it was a great experience. The staff were very friendly and welcoming. They carried out a full assessment of my dog and the best part was that the first visit was completely free as a complimentary offer. I really appreciated the care and professionalism and would definitely recommend them.

You all are amazing!!! The way you guys gently handled Maya and comforted her (although she was hiding all the time) during the appointment made me feel at ease even though I was worried. I’m grateful to have found such a compassionate and dedicated vet. Thank you so much. 🩷 …
Wonderful staff. Great advice.

I have been taking Gracie my cat to Medivet Nottinghill for over 10 years since I picked her up from Battersea. Everyone is very friendly and the Vets always give me good advice for my cat's care and wellbeing. Also they efficiently deliver Gracie's shots with the minimum of fuss despite the fact that Gracie would really prefer not to be there!
Notting Hill MediVet, warm, caring somehow miraculously just knows your dog's name even if you are just swinging by withot an appointment. 5 Stars all around.
Great vets, registered & appoint booked straight away, seen on time, not pushy with services that aren't needed, great advice and care shown for my fur baby
Great service they did follow up and were very kind for my cat.

Great Vets
Fantastic friendly staff
They explain everything
Clean environment
It’s a really nice vets. Really impressed.
Very lovely staff. Looked after my kitten and made me feel like he was the cutest kitten in the world. Very friendly

I can’t thank the staff at Medivet enough for their kindness they showed our elderly cat throughout his diagnosis. They made our experience better, and put us worried owners at ease from the beginning. Nurse Nicole and vet (I think Zoe) are clearly in their right profession!

Had a really great experience at Medivet Notting Hill. Nurse Nicole was absolutely lovely — calm, kind, and genuinely caring. She made my cat feel comfortable straight away and took the time to explain everything clearly without any rushing.
The whole environment was calm, very clean, and completely stress-free, which made such a difference. The bill was also very reasonable, with clear costs explained upfront. You can tell they really care about both the animals and their owners. Highly recommend!
Very helpful and professional

Fraser and Nicole were honestly amazing. They were so gentle and kind with my cat, and they really looked after me too when I got emotional. You can tell they truly care, and it made such a difference. I felt really supported and my cat was in the best hands 💜💜💜 …

I am deeply grateful to Nicole at Medvet ] for the way she cared for my cat, Saffry, after he was tragically hit by a car. She found me through his microchip to deliver the heartbreaking news that he hadn’t survived.

When I arrived, Nicole had gently wrapped him in a little blanket, with such a peaceful expression on his face that it felt like he was just sleeping. She was incredibly compassionate and empathetic, giving me the time I needed to say goodbye to my beloved boy. She also gave me a beautiful condolence card with his paw print, something I will treasure forever. ❤️❤️❤️😢

Thank you, Nicole, for your kindness, care, and respect during such a painful moment. Your compassion brought me comfort when I needed it the most.

First and last time to go to this vet clinic. Worst experience of our life. My cat was so poorly and was sent home without the necessary care not even an explanation to what was wrong with her. We had to get another emergency appointment with another clinic due to the severity of her case and continuous bleeding and weakness. She had all the necessary tests without sedation even though this clinic confirmed it was necessary and put her at risk in doing so. The clinic was freezing cold and they knew we were coming with new born kittens as they advised to bring them with mother. As a result of their carelessness we lost a baby.  I would never recommend to anyone nor would I ever go back!
We had a wonderful, calm visit

We've been bringing our dog here for the last four years or so - our dog is healthy and generally doesn't have many needs aside from one prescription, so the treatment he's received is straightforward and in the treatment itself, Medivet is fine.  The administrative, organizational and other aspects of this Medivet, however, are terrible.  Inconsistent feedback, zero follow up, unhelpful and high turnover staff - we constantly have to call and follow up with the vet for prescription renewals, only to be told (quite literally after 3-4 weeks of chasing AND paying for the prescriptions) that our dog suddenly needs to be seen.  It's left us in a pinch a few times before as we've needed the prescription ahead of boarding and despite multiple follow ups, Medivet has been completely unresponsive and unhelpful, leading to our dog potentially not having the medication he needs on a timely basis due to their inconsistency, which seems completely unacceptable for a veterinary service.  Another vet has opened just down the street called Creature Comforts and the user experience there has been much better so far.
Great place they showed such kindness to our dog Bob

I took my cat  for the first time and it went incredibly well. I am so happy with the service of the staff. Eloi took great care with our cat and addressed all of our concerns reassuringly.
- thank you Eloi :)
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Brilliant service

Great visit , nurses are amazing efficient taking great care of our loved kittens.
Ruby, Emma thank you. The vet Natasha talked me through procedures. Caring, professional staff.
Very friendly staff ,my fur baby was.very calm and relaxed.
Five Stars!

My mini schnauzer had a cracked tooth that needed to be extracted, and the team at Medivet—Natasha, Nicole, and Ruby—were absolutely fantastic. They were welcoming, reassuring, and incredibly gentle with our little patient (who is quite the scaredy-cat). They went the extra mile to fit us in, recommend the best option in terms of both outcome and cost, and ensure our pup was as comfortable as possible. They also provided us with all the necessary information in a very clear way, and the procedure was carried out smoothly. Honestly, I can’t recommend this vet practice more highly!

My dog Betty had a dental extraction a few weeks ago and because of her heart murmur, Nicole had to come to our house to check her BP and see if she could have the surgery. Ruby, Nicole and Natasha were so great at keeping me updated, being very sweet with Betty and helping my thank you letter to a previous vet to arrive safe. Amazing team!

All the staff at the surgery - from Natasha the vet, to Nicole the nurse & Ruby on the front desk, were very friendly & professional.

My cat, Mabel, underwent dental surgery. She received excellent treatment which was explained clearly to me along with the aftercare she needed.

I was very happy & would thoroughly recommend this practice.
Friendly, professional and caring. Thank you Ruby at Medivet Notting Hill !!!
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

Thanks to Natasha, Ruby and Molly for great service today and being very sweet with my dog and warm and accommodating with me. This visit really reinforced my decision to come back to Medivet after trying out the other vet nearby, where pet care was so blatantly a distant second priority behind scaremongering to make money. Big thank you!

Highly recommend Medivet Notting Hill for the friendliest and most professional staff. My dog had a dental procedure (conducted by Vet Avneen) who supported me throughout the whole process - from diagnosis to his release. Nurse Nicole took such great care of my dog all day and updated me throughout the procedure which I really appreciated.
Huge thank you to Ruby who coordinated (with a side of doggy cuddles!)
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.
Ruby and Natasha were incredible - so helpful and so kind <3
The Staff here are always so nice and helpful and they make you feel at ease. Thank you so much Natasha, Nicole and Ruby. Keep up the great work.

I am so pleased we found this practice. The vets handle their patients with care and gentleness putting them at ease. They provide clear explanations and options. The VCA’s and nurses are obviously crazy about animals, their welcome ensures a wag of the tail. It is a perfect combination of professionalism and compassion.
Such a lovely practice, always super friendly and helpful. My vet was Avneen and her assistant was Ruby :)
Isla could not have been more kind or helpful.

Staff are lovely, incredibly helpful and so devoted to the wellbeing of my pet! Very easy to contact as well, and it’s really handy to be able to book an appointment online.
Cant say enough great things about our experience here. They took exceptional care of our puppy and were very friendly and professional to work with. I would tell everyone to bring their pet here.
Thank you for your review. Your rating is really appreciated.

I wish I was joking as I've never experienced anything like this. The vet was extremely unprofessional, repeatedly mentioning her wealthy clients, how Notting Hill is such a wealthy area, and even how people feed their pets better food than they eat themselves. She also talked about her son flying in private jets, which was completely irrelevant and inappropriate.

When discussing my pet's needs, she insensitively remarked, “if you can’t afford the pricey surgery, it’s okay.” This was incredibly unprofessional and made me feel uncomfortable. Throughout the appointment, she laughed inappropriately and couldn't answer my questions properly.

Instead of focusing on my pet's health, she indulged in off-topic chitchat and made sure to add unnecessary items to the bill. The entire experience was horrible, and I will never be coming back.

ABSOLUTE WORST vets in London.

Lost all hope with the brand 'Medivet' I've dealt with them for years and they've been very sneaky with prices, overpriced while providing terrible service.

Wrong dosage prescribed to my cat which caused her other organs to suffer, now I'm footing bills for other ailments due to overdosage! I went to another more reliable vet who actually cares about the animals not just the money they receive, who clearly stated the dosage for the weight of my cat should have been much lesser and due to this her kidneys have failed.

They are not attentive and just have no care for the animal they treat, I know by experience. Emma is always rude whenever she answers the phone and very abrupt, she'll manage to blame you for their mistakes, very manipulative and uncaring.

I've moved vets because of how much my pet has suffered and hope none of you have to go through what she or I did
A highly recommended veterinarian and very polite, friendly and knowledgeable staff.
